==Hero Usage==
* Heroes will maintain this skill on party members with one of the following skills: [[Contagion]], [[Soul Taker]], [[Signet of Agony]], [[Touch of Agony]], [[Wallow's Bite]].
* Heroes will maintain this skill on allies under Masochism, when:
** They are wielding a melee weapon.
** They have two or more adjacent enemies.
* Targets with sacrifice skills and adjacent enemies are prioritized in combat.
* Heroes do not prioritize team members by their number of skills with a health sacrifice.
* Skills that are manually disabled are still counted.

== Notes ==
* You lose ''more'' health as Dark Aura deals ''more'' damage with each rank in Death Magic.

{{anomaly|Does not cause charmable animals to turn hostile.}}

;Player builds
* This skill is frequently used by [[Saccer]]s to forced-trigger [[Death Nova]].
** Combine Dark Aura with [[Touch skill|touch]] or point-blank skills that require sacrifices such as [[Signet of Agony]] and [[Touch of Agony]].  Other sacrifice skills, touch skills, or point-blank skills may also work well.

;AI tactics
* If triggered too rapidly in [[PvE]], [[creature]]s will flee the [[AoE]].
